name: B-sharkdp__bat-when-1
answer_head: - bat has a `vendored-libgit2` Cargo feature, defined as `vendored-libgit2 = ["git2/vendored-libgit2"]` at `Cargo.toml:35`. It forwards to git2's vendored (build from source) option. That mapping is my reading of the feature name and the `git2/vendored-libgit2` target. I did not check git2's own man
